svg.title: Gifford Auditorium row numbering as seen when entering from the back, high contrast
svg.desc: Plan of the auditorium with the stage at the top and the back wall at the bottom. The center aisle divides the seating into the Orange section on the left, which contains the teaching station, and the Blue section on the right. Rows are numbered 1 at the front nearest the stage through 17 against the back wall. Bar lengths show the seats in each row and section: rows 9 to 13 are the widest, rows 6 and 7 the narrowest, and row 1 the shortest of the main block.
